label: Exact event probabilities of the shared-plus-local assertion profile
paraphrase: For every product of a probability measure κ on a finite shared coordinate with n≥1 independent copies of a probability measure ν on a finite local coordinate, with assertion i true when the shared state lies in G and local state i lies in C: each assertion has probability κ(G)·ν(C), all n together κ(G)·ν(C)^n, at least one false 1−κ(G)·ν(C)^n; for a local flag event F, no flag anywhere has probability ν(Fᶜ)^n, and all true with no flag κ(G)·ν(C∩Fᶜ)^n. The independence is stipulated by the product construction; the profile is an analyst comparison model, not a model of the Truth Core corpus. See docs/notes/preface-connectivity-1584.md.
